interface.longDescription: Flinty helps teams inspect SEO content and search performance, monitor AI visibility and citations, create topic clusters, generate or refresh articles, schedule publication, and audit public pages through ChatGPT.

name: app-6a8dae7115348191970f45682684b8e0

positive.description: List recent topic clusters with bounded pagination metadata.
positive.prompt: Show my 10 most recent topic clusters and tell me if there are more results.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 recent clusters with their status, publication metrics, and a has_more indicator.

positive.description: Inspect search performance for a specific period.
positive.prompt: Show my Google Search Console performance for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns clicks, impressions, and average position; top queries may be empty when no live Search Console connection is configured.

positive.description: Review recent AI visibility results for the authenticated site.
positive.prompt: Show my 10 latest AI visibility analyses, including brand mentions and citation results.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest stored GEO analyses with prompts, status, brand data, results, and analysis dates.

positive.description: Create a new private topic cluster for a supported locale.
positive.prompt: Create a French topic cluster named Automatisation du marketing par email.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the cluster and returns its identifier, name, slug, status, and locale without publishing content.

positive.description: Run and store an SEO audit for a public page.
positive.prompt: Audit the public page https://example.com and give me its SEO score and top recommendations.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a stored audit with status, score, audit time, and actionable findings, or a clear fetch error.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger an unsupported destructive bulk deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete every article and topic cluster from my account.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unsupported Reddit posting.
negative.prompt: Post a promotional comment about my company to this Reddit thread.

publication.release_notes: Replaced the template MCP URL with the fixed universal endpoint https://mcp.flintyapp.com/mcp. Tenant selection now occurs during OAuth, and every access token remains bound to one Flinty site.
